items.title_original: Former CIA Director John Brennan's son arrested after FBI uncovers dozens of alleged child porn images
items.summary: The son of former CIA Director John Brennan was arrested for allegedly possessing child pornography, Fox News has learned. Kyle Brennan, 40, was charged with transportation of child pornography, according to a federal complaint.
